purpose: Documents the sensitivity-floor choice behind the FIXED operating threshold 0.367. This sweep does not revisit the threshold.
method: committed rule src/dhikra/model.py::screening_threshold (highest threshold with sensitivity >= floor, maximising specificity; thresholds quantised to 3 dp) applied to the locked development OOF vector results/summary/oof_predictions.npy / oof_labels.npy

code_conflict_documented.observation: screening_threshold's DEFAULT min_sensitivity is 0.85 (src/dhikra/model.py), while the deployed threshold 0.367 corresponds to floor 0.75 (confirmed docs/RECONSTRUCTION.md sect 2.8).
code_conflict_documented.resolution: The 0.85 default predates the development-time choice of 0.75; the deployed invocation passed 0.75 explicitly. Documented here and in a code comment; the default and the operating threshold are unchanged.

_provenance.dataset: Pitt+Delaware locked development pool, 987 recordings, 581 participants
